### What is TANFUND ?

TANFUND is a premier fund aggregator promoted by StartupTN, the Tamil Nadu Government’s nodal agency for Startup and Innovation. This platform connects innovative and scalable Startups across a wide spectrum of sectors with diverse funding partners.

#### Submission of Application

##### Step 1

#### Submission of Application

Startups introduce themselves by detailing their business, team, product or service, market and specific funding requirements.

![](https://www.tanfund.in/images/landing/point.svg)

#### Allotment to Funding Partners

##### Step 2

#### Allotment to Funding Partners

Based on the funding ask and other relevant details, The application is assigned to potential funding partners who would be interested in the specific domain or stage of the Startup.

![](https://www.tanfund.in/images/landing/point.svg)

#### Evaluation Phase

##### Step 3

#### Evaluation Phase

The designated investment partner reviews the application, may conduct preliminary meeting with the Startup or make a decision based on the data provided.

![](https://www.tanfund.in/images/landing/point.svg)

#### Due Diligence Round

##### Step 4

#### Due Diligence Round

The successful Startup moves thorough due diligence phase, where the investment partner evaluates the financial records, product viability, market potential, team credentials and other pertinent details.

![](https://www.tanfund.in/images/landing/point.svg)

#### Finalization of Investment Sheet

##### Step 5

#### Finalization of Investment Sheet

Once the due diligence is satisfactory, the Startup and the investment partner discuss and finalise the terms of investment - funding, equity share, milestones and other related agreements.

### Funding Partners

![](https://www.tanfund.in/images/landing/f1.svg)

##### Venture Capitalists

Professional entities managing pooled investor funds to invest in Startups, offering capital, expertise, and networks.

![](https://www.tanfund.in/images/landing/pv.png)

##### Private Equity

Invests in mature companies, often taking controlling interests. Focuses on scaling and optimizing businesses.

![](https://www.tanfund.in/images/landing/f3.svg)

##### Venture Debt

Debt financing for venture-backed startups lacking traditional collateral, complementing equity financing.

![](https://www.tanfund.in/images/landing/f4.svg)

##### Family Offices

Manages wealth of high-net-worth families and making private equity investments with a long-term horizon.

![](https://www.tanfund.in/images/landing/f5.svg)

##### Revenue-based Financing

Startups receive capital in exchange for a percentage of ongoing gross revenues. Repayment is tied to revenue performance.

![](https://www.tanfund.in/images/landing/f6.svg)

##### Angel Networks

Groups of HNIs pool resources to co-invest in Startups, sharing deal flow and due diligence.

![](https://www.tanfund.in/images/landing/f7.svg)

##### Government Investment Agencies

Support Startups with funding, mentorship and networks for economic growth, innovation, employment creation and social inclusion.

![](https://www.tanfund.in/images/landing/f8.svg)

##### Accelerator

Structured growth hacking programmes with mentorship and access to various resources, linked with seed investment.
